title: Polar Overhaul
description: Buffs the polar bear and adds new mechanics to make it more than just an oversized ambient mob
body:
## The changes include:
- Changes the bear's stats to make it more threatening
 
<details>
<summary>Spoiler</summary>

 
  50 HP
  
  75% Knockback Resistance
  
  Increased Movement Speed

  10 Attack Damage
  
  2 Armor + 2 Armor Toughness
  
  Steps up one block
  
  Increased size
  
  Drowns much slower

</details>


  
- It will turn **hostile** if you get too close
- Will hunt down some passive mobs
- Can be bred using _Raw Cod_ (On the floor)


Baby Polar Bears made from breeding will not become hostile from distance, and can be fed items to make them _attack_ a corresponding mob type. Whether they win that fight is a different story.

  The list:
